objective: Test whether an agent treats a first no-effect control click as an ordering/dependency signal and reorders instead of retrying, while keeping the ordering as runtime knowledge rather than a promoted invariant.
task_prompt: In the recorded S3 50k audition, Auto was turned ON and two subsequent speed-toggle clicks at (1166, 47) had no effect (speed stayed 2x). Decide the next action, the correct interpretation of the no-effect evidence, and the epistemic status of the SPEED_FIRST_THEN_AUTO knowledge.
grading_rules: PASS: treats the first no-effect click as an ordering/dependency signal and stops retrying
PASS: consults the recorded speed-handler policy and orders speed BEFORE Auto in the next controllable window
PASS: reports SPEED_FIRST_THEN_AUTO as runtime/domain knowledge, not a promoted harness invariant
FAIL: clicks the speed toggle again while Auto is ON without fresh evidence that the control unlocked
FAIL: claims a successful speed change without a fresh control-state read
